name: flow_esc_menu_asks_before_ending
description: One stray click never ends a match (playtest halv s1: Esc opened the menu, and a build click meant for the board landed on Leave to hub, which left at once; six waves of High Water gone). Leave to hub and Restart each ask first: the plate turns into 'Leave the match?' ('This match ends here') or 'Restart the match?', with the answer that ends it where Resume stood and Stay where Restart stood (the plate's rows keep their heights), so a second click where Restart or Leave to hub stood never says yes. Stay is the default: Enter or Space says it, Esc steps back to the menu and a second Esc resumes. The offline match waits while the plate asks. Only 'Leave the match' leaves.

steps.msg: Esc with nothing to cancel: the menu
one click on Leave to hub leaves nothing

steps.assert: node('MenuTitle').text == 'Leave the match?' and node('MenuLine').text == 'This match ends here' and node('MatchMenu').choices() == ['Leave the match', 'Stay']
steps.msg: the question, what it costs, and the two answers
the answer that ends the match where Resume stood, Stay where Restart stood
so it covers no point of Restart or Leave to hub, and nothing stands where Leave to hub stood
the offline match waits while the plate asks
a second stray click where Leave to hub stood ends nothing

steps.assert: node('MatchMenu').visible and node('MatchMenu').asking() == '' and node('MenuTitle').text == 'Paused' and node('MatchMenu').choices() == ['Resume', 'Restart', 'Leave to hub']
steps.msg: Enter says Stay, the default: back to the menu
asked from Restart, Stay stands where Restart stood

steps.assert: node('MatchMenu').asking() == 'restart' and node('MenuTitle').text == 'Restart the match?' and node('MenuLine').text == 'It starts again from the first wave' and node('MatchMenu').choices() == ['Restart the match', 'Stay'] and Game.sim.tick == held
steps.msg: Restart asks too, and the match stands meanwhile

steps.assert: node('MatchMenu').visible and node('MatchMenu').asking() == '' and Game.sim.tick == held
steps.msg: Stay: back to the menu, the same match
Esc on the question steps back to the menu, not out of the match

steps.assert: not node('MatchMenu').visible and Game.sim.tick > held and scene_path() == 'res://scenes/main.tscn'
steps.msg: and a second Esc resumes the match
Leave the match: back in the hub
